Assistant A's implementation:
```
def findCommonElements(arr1, arr2): 
    # Create a set of elements present in both arrays 
    common_elems = set(arr1).intersection(arr2) 
  
    # Return common elements 
    return common_elems
```
This implementation creates a set of common elements by using the intersection method, which is efficient and does not require any extra data structures. The time complexity of this implementation is O(n), where n is the length of the arrays. This is the best time complexity possible for this problem.
